sections.name: A bike the app cannot drive, on the fake trainer

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0650.1","TST-0650.2","TST-0650.3"],"Turn on Send a Machine Status every second, packet Default. Ride forty minutes, then share and read the Bluetooth log."]
checks.action: Turn on Send a Machine Status every second, packet Default. Ride forty minutes, then share and read the Bluetooth log.
checks.expected: The export's connect-time block is at the top and complete: characteristic table, 0x2ACC feature and target bits, Request Control and Start/Resume responses. **A repeated line appears once, with a count**, such as `[FTMS] Status notification: [4] (x2400)`, not hundreds of times. The Indoor Bike Data flags word appears exactly once, with its field names decoded. MAC addresses still read `device_1`, `device_2`.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0650.4"],"Mid-ride, disconnect and reconnect the fake trainer. Share the log again. Then turn repeated status off."]
checks.action: Mid-ride, disconnect and reconnect the fake trainer. Share the log again. Then turn repeated status off.
checks.expected: The pinned block describes the current connection, and the counts start again.

checks.action: Read the target and the cue where the intensity percentage used to be.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0649.2"],"Ride under the target, then over it, and hold power on a boundary."]
checks.action: Ride under the target, then over it, and hold power on a boundary.
checks.expected: The cue changes at ±5% and again at ±10%, without flickering on a boundary. The power number keeps its normal colour throughout.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0649.3"],"Read the centre column."]
checks.action: Read the centre column.
checks.expected: The centre column is unchanged: current watts, w/kg, `AVG | MAX`, `TARGET: N W`.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0649.4"],"Start Quick Ride, the ERG free ride, and read the intensity row."]
checks.action: Start Quick Ride, the ERG free ride, and read the intensity row.
checks.expected: Quick Ride is unchanged, with watts ± still there.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0649.5"],"Start an HR-Zone workout. Read the large power number and the row beneath it."]
checks.action: Start an HR-Zone workout. Read the large power number and the row beneath it.
checks.expected: The large number is the rider's own power. The suggestion sits where the intensity row was, as a wattage with an arrow.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0653.3"],"Read the large number, the suggestion arrow and the label beside it."]
checks.action: Read the large number, the suggestion arrow and the label beside it.
checks.expected: The row reads `TARGET n W` with the arrow and delta beside it, in the deviation band's colour. No `SUGGEST` pill.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0649.6"],"Hold power well away from the suggestion for two minutes, watching the suggestion."]
checks.action: Hold power well away from the suggestion for two minutes, watching the suggestion.
checks.expected: The suggestion stays near what the rider is doing. It does not walk down 309, 299, 289… as the controller's own target does.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0649.7"],"Stop pedalling until power reads 0."]
checks.action: Stop pedalling until power reads 0.
checks.expected: The suggestion holds its last value rather than collapsing toward zero.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0649.8"],"Time how often the suggestion changes, going up and going down."]
checks.action: Time how often the suggestion changes, going up and going down.
checks.expected: The suggestion changes no more often than every 20 s upward and every 10 s downward.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0649.9"],"Start Zone Ride, the HR-Zone free ride."]
checks.action: Start Zone Ride, the HR-Zone free ride.
checks.expected: Zone Ride has the same design, and the zone selector is still present.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0649.10"],"End any ride. Start a route, terrain view primary. Read the controls and grade, then pedal and watch the speed."]
checks.action: End any ride. Start a route, terrain view primary. Read the controls and grade, then pedal and watch the speed.
checks.expected: No gear control and no slope-mode chip, and the grade is still displayed. The rider's speed still responds to the gradient.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0653.4"],"Read the pacer, the control row, the next-segment marker and the cadence tile."]
checks.action: Read the pacer, the control row, the next-segment marker and the cadence tile.
checks.expected: Grade shown; no gear control or slope chip. Pacer on, not dismissible. Row: segment line, `TARGET N W`. Profile: next-segment marker. Cadence: `AIM 75`.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0653.5"],"Switch the map to primary."]
checks.action: Switch the map to primary.
checks.expected: The pacer draws on the map too, and the control row reads as it did with the terrain primary.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0649.11"],"End the route. Start a free ride in SIM."]
checks.action: End the route. Start a free ride in SIM.
checks.expected: SLOPE ± is still present. The gear control and the chip are gone.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0653.6"],"Read the target row and the pacer gap on the growing profile."]
checks.action: Read the target row and the pacer gap on the growing profile.
checks.expected: SLOPE ± is present, the gear control is gone, the row reads `TARGET N W`, and the pacer gap line is on the growing profile.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0649.12"],"Look across the Power, HR-Zone, Zone Ride, Route and Free Ride cockpits for anything suggesting a speed."]
checks.action: Look across the Power, HR-Zone, Zone Ride, Route and Free Ride cockpits for anything suggesting a speed.
checks.expected: Nothing anywhere suggests a speed.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0653.7"],"Share the Bluetooth log and read it."]
checks.action: Share the Bluetooth log and read it.
checks.expected: The log carries the capability transition, the suppressed-writes line once, and the flags word.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0653.8"],"Read both platforms' screenshots of the data-only screens side by side."]
checks.action: Read both platforms' screenshots of the data-only screens side by side.
checks.expected: Both platforms match in wording, position and presence. On every cockpit the target sits in one place and is never called `PACER`.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0649.14"],"Open the manual's page on riding a bike the app cannot control, in English and one other language."]
checks.action: Open the manual's page on riding a bike the app cannot control, in English and one other language.
checks.expected: The page describes what the data-only cockpits showed, and says plainly that the bike's wattage is an estimate.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.1","TST-0648.2"],"Set Refuses control, reconnect. Ride Power until it latches; end it. Read the trainer row and details in two languages."]
checks.action: Set Refuses control, reconnect. Ride Power until it latches; end it. Read the trainer row and details in two languages.
checks.expected: The Power workout starts on the refusing fake trainer. The row shows the hand mark and *Resistance by hand* **once**; its Resistance row reads *Set by hand*. Both read correctly translated.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.3"],"Open Settings → Hardware → Diagnostics and read the log."]
checks.action: Open Settings → Hardware → Diagnostics and read the log.
checks.expected: The log shows `Control capability: unknown → data-only` with its source, after two refusal votes, each followed by a re-issued Request Control.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.4"],"Start a Power workout, then read the log again."]
checks.action: Start a Power workout, then read the log again.
checks.expected: **No control write appears in the log after the latch**, and exactly one line says writes are suppressed.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.5"],"Start an HR-Zone workout and read the row beneath the large number. Take a screenshot."]
checks.action: Start an HR-Zone workout and read the row beneath the large number. Take a screenshot.
checks.expected: The row reads `TARGET n W` with the arrow and delta beside it, and never pulses. No `SUGGEST` pill. It looks different from a KICKR's.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0656.1"],"Open Settings → Hardware → Trainer compatibility check and run the test. Watch the progress bar."]
checks.evidence: [{"result":"fail","reason":"This is not the right logic, since these trainers are valid trainers, we should make it possible for these people to get a free pro license if they validate their trainer fully.","date":"2026-09-13"}]
checks.action: Open Settings → Hardware → Trainer compatibility check and run the test. Watch the progress bar.
checks.expected: The test runs the warmup and stops, and **the progress bar reaches the end** rather than stalling near 15%.
checks.reason: This is not the right logic, since these trainers are valid trainers, we should make it possible for these people to get a free pro license if they validate their trainer fully.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.6"],"Read the ERG, Simulation and resistance rows and the verdict. Check the log for the test's control writes, then return."]
checks.action: Read the ERG, Simulation and resistance rows and the verdict. Check the log for the test's control writes, then return.
checks.expected: The ERG, Simulation and resistance rows read N/A with a reason. The verdict does not blame the bike, and no control write is attempted.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0656.2"],"Read Pairing, IBD reporting, each dispatch, each transition and endurance."]
checks.evidence: [{"result":"fail","reason":"This is not the right logic, since these trainers are valid trainers, we should make it possible for these people to get a free pro license if they validate their trainer fully.","date":"2026-09-13"}]
checks.action: Read Pairing, IBD reporting, each dispatch, each transition and endurance.
checks.expected: Pairing, IBD reporting and Endurance read PASS. ERG, SIM and resistance dispatch and all three transitions read N/A with a reason. None reads FAIL.
checks.reason: This is not the right logic, since these trainers are valid trainers, we should make it possible for these people to get a free pro license if they validate their trainer fully.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0656.8"],"On the iOS device, read the grant result and look for a submission screen."]
checks.evidence: [{"result":"fail","reason":"This is not the right logic, since these trainers are valid trainers, we should make it possible for these people to get a free pro license if they validate their trainer fully.","date":"2026-09-13"}]
checks.action: On the iOS device, read the grant result and look for a submission screen.
checks.expected: The data-only scorecard reports no grant, and there is no submission screen. That is the parity position, not a regression.
checks.reason: This is not the right logic, since these trainers are valid trainers, we should make it possible for these people to get a free pro license if they validate their trainer fully.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0656.3"],"On the Android device, look for the Pro upgrade offer on the scorecard."]
checks.evidence: [{"result":"fail","reason":"This is not the right logic, since these trainers are valid trainers, we should make it possible for these people to get a free pro license if they validate their trainer fully.","date":"2026-09-13"}]
checks.action: On the Android device, look for the Pro upgrade offer on the scorecard.
checks.expected: **The screen does not offer the Pro upgrade**, and does not say the rider is eligible for it.
checks.reason: This is not the right logic, since these trainers are valid trainers, we should make it possible for these people to get a free pro license if they validate their trainer fully.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0656.4"],"On the Android device, read what the screen says about failed sub-tests and retrying."]
checks.evidence: [{"result":"fail","reason":"This is not the right logic, since these trainers are valid trainers, we should make it possible for these people to get a free pro license if they validate their trainer fully.","date":"2026-09-13"}]
checks.action: On the Android device, read what the screen says about failed sub-tests and retrying.
checks.expected: It does not ask the rider to fix failed sub-tests and retry. It says the grant is for verifying trainer control; this bike has none.
checks.reason: This is not the right logic, since these trainers are valid trainers, we should make it possible for these people to get a free pro license if they validate their trainer fully.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0656.5"],"On the Android device, look for a way to submit the scorecard."]
checks.evidence: [{"result":"fail","reason":"This is not the right logic, since these trainers are valid trainers, we should make it possible for these people to get a free pro license if they validate their trainer fully.","date":"2026-09-13"}]
checks.action: On the Android device, look for a way to submit the scorecard.
checks.expected: **The scorecard can still be submitted.**
checks.reason: This is not the right logic, since these trainers are valid trainers, we should make it possible for these people to get a free pro license if they validate their trainer fully.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0656.6"],"On the Android device, copy the scorecard's JSON and read it."]
checks.evidence: [{"result":"fail","reason":"This is not the right logic, since these trainers are valid trainers, we should make it possible for these people to get a free pro license if they validate their trainer fully.","date":"2026-09-13"}]
checks.action: On the Android device, copy the scorecard's JSON and read it.
checks.expected: The JSON carries `"test_version": "2"`, `"control_capability": "data_only"` and `"qualifies_for_grant": false`.
checks.reason: This is not the right logic, since these trainers are valid trainers, we should make it possible for these people to get a free pro license if they validate their trainer fully.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.7"],"Turn on Use the bundled test list. Open the compatibility check and find Nautilus Schwinn 800IC."]
checks.action: Turn on Use the bundled test list. Open the compatibility check and find Nautilus Schwinn 800IC.
checks.expected: The entry renders as its own bucket, not as *not listed*.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.8"],"Set Refuses once and reconnect. Ride a Power workout; read the capability in the Hub and the log's control writes."]
checks.action: Set Refuses once and reconnect. Ride a Power workout; read the capability in the Hub and the log's control writes.
checks.expected: The capability never leaves `drivable`, and control writes continue after the one refusal.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.9"],"Set Refuses control again, reconnect, and read the capability."]
checks.action: Set Refuses control again, reconnect, and read the capability.
checks.expected: The capability starts at `unknown` again.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.10"],"Set Feature read timeout and reconnect. Start a Power workout. Read the capability, the trainer row and the control writes."]
checks.action: Set Feature read timeout and reconnect. Start a Power workout. Read the capability, the trainer row and the control writes.
checks.expected: The capability stays `unknown`, writes continue, and the trainer row carries no hand mark.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.11"],"Set No Control Point, reconnect, and read the capability."]
checks.action: Set No Control Point, reconnect, and read the capability.
checks.expected: The capability is `data-only` immediately, before any write.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.12"],"Latch with Refuses control. Set Off, connect the KICKR, read its cockpits, and compare HR-Zone with the screenshot."]
checks.action: Latch with Refuses control. Set Off, connect the KICKR, read its cockpits, and compare HR-Zone with the screenshot.
checks.expected: No manual-resistance line, no data-only `TARGET` readout, and the gear and slope-mode controls are present.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0649.13"],"Repeat every data-only cockpit step on the KICKR, against the gallery captures."]
checks.action: Repeat every data-only cockpit step on the KICKR, against the gallery captures.
checks.expected: On the KICKR the cockpit is as before this phase: gear control, slope chip, intensity percentage, and the pill's Applied and Predicted states.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.13"],"Run the compatibility test once on the KICKR and read its dispatch rows."]
checks.action: Run the compatibility test once on the KICKR and read its dispatch rows.
checks.expected: Nothing in the scorecard has changed for a trainer that works.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0650.10"],"On each platform, ride the KICKR for ten minutes and share the Bluetooth log."]
checks.action: On each platform, ride the KICKR for ten minutes and share the Bluetooth log.
checks.expected: Cadence, power and the displayed speed are exactly what they were. The export's format for a line that is not repeated is unchanged.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.14"],"In that log, read the control-response and Start/Resume lines."]
checks.action: In that log, read the control-response and Start/Resume lines.
checks.expected: The log carries a Control Point response line and a Start/Resume.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.15"],"Latch the fake trainer, connect the KICKR, and check its controls. Reconnect the fake trainer with Off; read its verdict."]
checks.action: Latch the fake trainer, connect the KICKR, and check its controls. Reconnect the fake trainer with Off; read its verdict.
checks.expected: The KICKR is driven: gear and slope-mode controls are back, and no manual-resistance line. The reconnected fake trainer's verdict is derived again, not remembered.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0656.7"],"On the Android device, with Off and the fake trainer reconnected, run the test again and read the scorecard."]
checks.evidence: [{"result":"fail","reason":"This is not the right logic, since these trainers are valid trainers, we should make it possible for these people to get a free pro license if they validate their trainer fully.","date":"2026-09-13"}]
checks.action: On the Android device, with Off and the fake trainer reconnected, run the test again and read the scorecard.
checks.expected: Today's scorecard, grant copy and Submit button, in the wording TST-0350 asserts, unchanged.
checks.reason: This is not the right logic, since these trainers are valid trainers, we should make it possible for these people to get a free pro license if they validate their trainer fully.

sections.name: The navigation container, the equipment chrome and the rider token

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0666.1"],"Pick the second rider."]
checks.action: Pick the second rider.
checks.expected: Workouts opens, with at least one workout row showing unscrolled. The first destination shows the rider's name and bike mark in their colour.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0666.2"],"Read the navigation container."]
checks.action: Read the navigation container.
checks.expected: Four destinations: rider, Workouts, History, Settings. A bottom bar on phones, a left rail on tablets. No gear or kebab up top.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0669.1"],"Read the bottom bar, then the top bar."]
checks.action: Read the bottom bar, then the top bar.
checks.expected: Bar order: rider (mark in rider's colour, name in bar colour), Workouts, History, Settings. Top bar: no gear or rider chip; four equipment icons last.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0666.3"],"From Workouts, change the ride mode twice."]
checks.action: From Workouts, change the ride mode twice.
checks.expected: The three ride modes form one group on Workouts. Changing mode changes the library below without leaving Workouts.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0669.2"],"Tap History, then Workouts, then History again. Press Back."]
checks.action: Tap History, then Workouts, then History again. Press Back.
checks.expected: Each tap swaps the screen in place. Back lands on the Riders list, not back through Workouts and History.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0666.4"],"Open History and filter it."]
checks.action: Open History and filter it.
checks.expected: History shows All, Power, Route, HR-Zone and the personal-bests toggle, each with a readable label, not an icon alone.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0669.3"],"From History, tap the rider item, then Profile. Then tap Settings."]
checks.action: From History, tap the rider item, then Profile. Then tap Settings.
checks.expected: The current rider's profile opens. Settings opens as its own destination.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0667.1"],"Open Workouts and read the top bar."]
checks.action: Open Workouts and read the top bar.
checks.expected: Four indicators at the end, in the bar's text colour, none green. No rider chip, gear or kebab. The sparkle shows only on FREE.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0667.2"],"Tap the heart-rate icon."]
checks.action: Tap the heart-rate icon.
checks.expected: The Hub opens directly: Smart Trainer, Power, Cadence, Heart Rate, each naming its device and reading Connected.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0666.5"],"Close the Hub and reopen it from any icon. Open Profile from the rider item, switch rider, open Profile again."]
checks.action: Close the Hub and reopen it from any icon. Open Profile from the rider item, switch rider, open Profile again.
checks.expected: The Hub opens from the chrome, not through Settings, with four device rows. Profile opens for the current rider, and for the other after switching.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0667.3"],"In the Hub, tap the Cadence row and read its sheet. Close it, then tap the Smart Trainer row."]
checks.action: In the Hub, tap the Cadence row and read its sheet. Close it, then tap the Smart Trainer row.
checks.expected: Each opens a sheet with Sends, Change device and Forget. The trainer's adds Resistance and Run the compatibility test.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0669.4"],"Close the Hub. Switch the KICKR off and watch the top bar, then on. Open History and repeat."]
checks.action: Close the Hub. Switch the KICKR off and watch the top bar, then on. Open History and repeat.
checks.expected: On connect the trainer icon turns the bar's text colour, no slash. On drop it turns faint grey and slashed, on both screens.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0670.1"],"Force-quit, relaunch and pick the rider. Watch the equipment icons."]
checks.action: Force-quit, relaunch and pick the rider. Watch the equipment icons.
checks.expected: The trainer and heart-rate icons turn from faint grey with a slash to the bar's text colour without a tap. No picker opens.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0670.2"],"Switch the KICKR off and on so it drops. Open the Hub and read the Smart Trainer row."]
checks.action: Switch the KICKR off and on so it drops. Open the Hub and read the Smart Trainer row.
checks.expected: The row names the remembered trainer, reads *Disconnected*, and carries a Reconnect button.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0670.3"],"Tap Reconnect on the row."]
checks.action: Tap Reconnect on the row.
checks.expected: It connects without a picker, the row reads *Connected*, and the trainer icon is back in the bar's text colour with no slash.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0670.4"],"Switch the strap off and on so it drops. Read its row, then tap Reconnect."]
checks.action: Switch the strap off and on so it drops. Read its row, then tap Reconnect.
checks.expected: The same holds for the strap.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0671.1"],"Drop the KICKR again. Tap Reconnect on its row; power it off before it connects. Watch until it gives up."]
checks.action: Drop the KICKR again. Tap Reconnect on its row; power it off before it connects. Watch until it gives up.
checks.expected: *Connecting…* with a spinner, then *Couldn't connect* in red with a Reconnect button. The trainer icon turns red with a dot.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0671.2"],"Close the Hub. With the KICKR still off, pick a structured Power workout and wait."]
checks.action: Close the Hub. With the KICKR still off, pick a structured Power workout and wait.
checks.expected: The bar on Workouts reads *Connecting…* naming the trainer, then *Couldn't connect* with **Retry** and **Cancel**. The cockpit does not open.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0671.3"],"With the KICKR still off, tap Retry, then Cancel."]
checks.action: With the KICKR still off, tap Retry, then Cancel.
checks.expected: Retry starts another attempt. Cancel clears the bar and leaves nothing selected.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","android","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0666.6"],"Switch the KICKR on and let it connect. Turn the system's reduced motion on and re-enter Workouts."]
checks.action: Switch the KICKR on and let it connect. Turn the system's reduced motion on and re-enter Workouts.
checks.expected: The mode strip appears without animating.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0650.1","TST-0650.2","TST-0650.3"],"Ride forty minutes in repeated-status mode. Share the log from Settings → Equipment → Bluetooth Diagnostics."]
checks.action: Ride forty minutes in repeated-status mode. Share the log from Settings → Equipment → Bluetooth Diagnostics.
checks.expected: The export's connect-time block is at the top and complete: characteristic table, 0x2ACC feature and target bits, Request Control and Start/Resume responses. **A repeated line appears once, with a count**, such as `[FTMS] Status notification: [4] (x2400)`, not hundreds of times. The Indoor Bike Data flags word appears exactly once, with its field names decoded. MAC addresses still read `device_1`, `device_2`.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0650.4"],"Mid-ride, disconnect and reconnect the mock. Refresh the log in Bluetooth Diagnostics and share it again."]
checks.action: Mid-ride, disconnect and reconnect the mock. Refresh the log in Bluetooth Diagnostics and share it again.
checks.expected: The pinned block describes the current connection, and the counts start again.

checks.expected: It does not ask the rider to fix failed sub-tests and retry. It says the grant is for verifying trainer control; this bike has none.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0656.5"],"On the Android device, look for a way to submit the scorecard."]
checks.action: On the Android device, look for a way to submit the scorecard.
checks.expected: **The scorecard can still be submitted.**

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0656.6"],"On the Android device, copy the scorecard's JSON and read it."]
checks.action: On the Android device, copy the scorecard's JSON and read it.
checks.expected: The JSON carries `"test_version": "2"`, `"control_capability": "data_only"` and `"qualifies_for_grant": false`.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.7"],"Open Settings → Equipment → Check Trainer Compatibility, which reads the published list. Find its data-only entry."]
checks.action: Open Settings → Equipment → Check Trainer Compatibility, which reads the published list. Find its data-only entry.
checks.expected: The entry renders as its own bucket, not as *not listed*.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.8"],"Set capability Off, failure mode Refuses once. Restart, reconnect, ride a Power workout. Read the capability and later writes."]
checks.action: Set capability Off, failure mode Refuses once. Restart, reconnect, ride a Power workout. Read the capability and later writes.
checks.expected: The capability never leaves `drivable`, and control writes continue after the one refusal.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.9"],"Set failure mode Refuses control. Restart, reconnect the mock, and read its first capability."]
checks.action: Set failure mode Refuses control. Restart, reconnect the mock, and read its first capability.
checks.expected: The capability starts at `unknown` again.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.10"],"Set capability Feature read timeout, failure mode None. Restart, reconnect. Read the capability, control writes and Hub line."]
checks.action: Set capability Feature read timeout, failure mode None. Restart, reconnect. Read the capability, control writes and Hub line.
checks.expected: The capability stays `unknown`, writes continue, and the trainer row carries no hand mark.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.11"],"Set capability No Control Point, failure mode None. Restart, reconnect, and read the capability before any write."]
checks.action: Set capability No Control Point, failure mode None. Restart, reconnect, and read the capability before any write.
checks.expected: The capability is `data-only` immediately, before any write.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.12"],"Latch the mock with Refuses control. Mock off, failure mode None, restart. Connect the KICKR and compare with the screenshot."]
checks.action: Latch the mock with Refuses control. Mock off, failure mode None, restart. Connect the KICKR and compare with the screenshot.
checks.expected: No manual-resistance line, no data-only `TARGET` readout, and the gear and slope-mode controls are present.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0649.13"],"Capability Off, failure mode None, mock off. Restart, connect the KICKR, and repeat the cockpit steps against the gallery."]
checks.action: Capability Off, failure mode None, mock off. Restart, connect the KICKR, and repeat the cockpit steps against the gallery.
checks.expected: On the KICKR the cockpit is as before this phase: gear control, slope chip, intensity percentage, and the pill's Applied and Predicted states.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.13"],"Turn the mock off and restart. Connect the KICKR, run the compatibility test, and read its dispatch rows."]
checks.action: Turn the mock off and restart. Connect the KICKR, run the compatibility test, and read its dispatch rows.
checks.expected: Nothing in the scorecard has changed for a trainer that works.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0650.10"],"Capability Off, failure mode None, mock off. Restart, ride the KICKR ten minutes, share the log from Bluetooth Diagnostics."]
checks.action: Capability Off, failure mode None, mock off. Restart, ride the KICKR ten minutes, share the log from Bluetooth Diagnostics.
checks.expected: Cadence, power and the displayed speed are exactly what they were. The export's format for a line that is not repeated is unchanged.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.14"],"In that log, read the control-response and Start/Resume lines."]
checks.action: In that log, read the control-response and Start/Resume lines.
checks.expected: The log carries a Control Point response line and a Start/Resume.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0648.15"],"Latch with Refuses control. Mock off, restart, check the KICKR. Mock on, failure mode None, restart, read capability."]
checks.action: Latch with Refuses control. Mock off, restart, check the KICKR. Mock on, failure mode None, restart, read capability.
checks.expected: The KICKR is driven: gear and slope-mode controls are back, and no manual-resistance line. The reconnected fake trainer's verdict is derived again, not remembered.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","a-bike-the-app-cannot-drive-on-the-fake-trainer",["TST-0656.7"],"On the Android device, with Off and the fake trainer reconnected, run the test again and read the scorecard."]
checks.action: On the Android device, with Off and the fake trainer reconnected, run the test again and read the scorecard.
checks.expected: Today's scorecard, grant copy and Submit button, in the wording TST-0350 asserts, unchanged.

sections.name: The navigation container, the equipment chrome and the rider token

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0666.1"],"Pick the second rider."]
checks.action: Pick the second rider.
checks.expected: Workouts opens, with at least one workout row showing unscrolled. The first destination shows the rider's name and bike mark in their colour.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0666.2"],"Read the navigation container."]
checks.action: Read the navigation container.
checks.expected: Four destinations: rider, Workouts, History, Settings. A bottom bar on phones, a left rail on tablets. No gear or kebab up top.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0669.1"],"Read the bottom bar, then the top bar."]
checks.action: Read the bottom bar, then the top bar.
checks.expected: Bar order: rider (mark in rider's colour, name in bar colour), Workouts, History, Settings. Top bar: no gear or rider chip; four equipment icons last.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0666.3"],"From Workouts, change the ride mode twice."]
checks.action: From Workouts, change the ride mode twice.
checks.expected: The three ride modes form one group on Workouts. Changing mode changes the library below without leaving Workouts.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0669.2"],"Tap History, then Workouts, then History again. Press Back."]
checks.action: Tap History, then Workouts, then History again. Press Back.
checks.expected: Each tap swaps the screen in place. Back lands on the Riders list, not back through Workouts and History.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0666.4"],"Open History and filter it."]
checks.action: Open History and filter it.
checks.expected: History shows All, Power, Route, HR-Zone and the personal-bests toggle, each with a readable label, not an icon alone.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0669.3"],"From History, tap the rider item, then Profile. Then tap Settings."]
checks.action: From History, tap the rider item, then Profile. Then tap Settings.
checks.expected: The current rider's profile opens. Settings opens as its own destination.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0667.1"],"Open Workouts and read the top bar."]
checks.action: Open Workouts and read the top bar.
checks.expected: Four indicators at the end, in the bar's text colour, none green. No rider chip, gear or kebab. The sparkle shows only on FREE.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0667.2"],"Tap the heart-rate icon."]
checks.action: Tap the heart-rate icon.
checks.expected: The Hub opens directly: Smart Trainer, Power, Cadence, Heart Rate, each naming its device and reading Connected.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0666.5"],"Close the Hub and reopen it from any icon. Open Profile from the rider item, switch rider, open Profile again."]
checks.action: Close the Hub and reopen it from any icon. Open Profile from the rider item, switch rider, open Profile again.
checks.expected: The Hub opens from the chrome, not through Settings, with four device rows. Profile opens for the current rider, and for the other after switching.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0667.3"],"In the Hub, tap the Cadence row and read its sheet. Close it, then tap the Smart Trainer row."]
checks.action: In the Hub, tap the Cadence row and read its sheet. Close it, then tap the Smart Trainer row.
checks.expected: Each opens a sheet with Sends, Change device and Forget. The trainer's adds Resistance and Run the compatibility test.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0669.4"],"Close the Hub. Switch the KICKR off and watch the top bar, then on. Open History and repeat."]
checks.action: Close the Hub. Switch the KICKR off and watch the top bar, then on. Open History and repeat.
checks.expected: On connect the trainer icon turns the bar's text colour, no slash. On drop it turns faint grey and slashed, on both screens.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0670.1"],"Force-quit, relaunch and pick the rider. Watch the equipment icons."]
checks.action: Force-quit, relaunch and pick the rider. Watch the equipment icons.
checks.expected: The trainer and heart-rate icons turn from faint grey with a slash to the bar's text colour without a tap. No picker opens.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0670.2"],"Switch the KICKR off and on so it drops. Open the Hub and read the Smart Trainer row."]
checks.action: Switch the KICKR off and on so it drops. Open the Hub and read the Smart Trainer row.
checks.expected: The row names the remembered trainer, reads *Disconnected*, and carries a Reconnect button.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0670.3"],"Tap Reconnect on the row."]
checks.action: Tap Reconnect on the row.
checks.expected: It connects without a picker, the row reads *Connected*, and the trainer icon is back in the bar's text colour with no slash.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0670.4"],"Switch the strap off and on so it drops. Read its row, then tap Reconnect."]
checks.action: Switch the strap off and on so it drops. Read its row, then tap Reconnect.
checks.expected: The same holds for the strap.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0671.1"],"Drop the KICKR again. Tap Reconnect on its row; power it off before it connects. Watch until it gives up."]
checks.action: Drop the KICKR again. Tap Reconnect on its row; power it off before it connects. Watch until it gives up.
checks.expected: *Connecting…* with a spinner, then *Couldn't connect* in red with a Reconnect button. The trainer icon turns red with a dot.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0671.2"],"Close the Hub. With the KICKR still off, pick a structured Power workout and wait."]
checks.action: Close the Hub. With the KICKR still off, pick a structured Power workout and wait.
checks.expected: The bar on Workouts reads *Connecting…* naming the trainer, then *Couldn't connect* with **Retry** and **Cancel**. The cockpit does not open.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0671.3"],"With the KICKR still off, tap Retry, then Cancel."]
checks.action: With the KICKR still off, tap Retry, then Cancel.
checks.expected: Retry starts another attempt. Cancel clears the bar and leaves nothing selected.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0666.6"],"Switch the KICKR on and let it connect. Turn the system's reduced motion on and re-enter Workouts."]
checks.action: Switch the KICKR on and let it connect. Turn the system's reduced motion on and re-enter Workouts.
checks.expected: The mode strip appears without animating.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0667.7"],"Power the power meter down. Pick a structured Power workout."]
checks.action: Power the power meter down. Pick a structured Power workout.
checks.expected: A Connecting state beneath the indicators names the power source. The cockpit does not open.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0667.8"],"Tap Cancel, then power the power meter up and pick the workout again."]
checks.action: Tap Cancel, then power the power meter up and pick the workout again.
checks.expected: After Cancel, the library with nothing selected. On the second pick the cockpit opens once the power source connects.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0666.7"],"Pick a structured Power workout. Read the cockpit before START, then start it and let it run a minute."]
checks.action: Pick a structured Power workout. Read the cockpit before START, then start it and let it run a minute.
checks.expected: Before START, four equipment icons up top; the rider's mark and name in the bar's left slot. The terrain glyph wears their colour.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0667.9"],"Tap the cadence icon. Pause, tap it again, and resume."]
checks.action: Tap the cadence icon. Pause, tap it again, and resume.
checks.expected: Running, a sheet with no chevrons where only Reconnect and cadence's Change source respond, and the timer counts. Paused: the full Hub.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0666.8"],"Power down the cadence source mid-ride."]
checks.action: Power down the cadence source mid-ride.
checks.expected: The cadence indicator turns faint grey with a slash, and no dot, and the ride carries on.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0667.4"],"Discard the ride."]
checks.action: Discard the ride.
checks.expected: The workout starts once every device it needs is connected. Discarding it returns to Workout Selection.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0667.5"],"Read the indicators and what sits beneath them."]
checks.action: Read the indicators and what sits beneath them.
checks.expected: Every bound indicator is faint grey with a slash, and no dot. Beneath: equipment not connected, with one action, Reconnect. No row reads Connected.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0667.6"],"Tap Reconnect once."]
checks.action: Tap Reconnect once.
checks.expected: All four indicators turn the app accent, then the bar's text colour, with no further tap.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0666.9"],"Count the actions it took to bring back the ride's equipment."]
checks.action: Count the actions it took to bring back the ride's equipment.
checks.expected: Restoring the ride's equipment is one action, not one per device.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0668.1"],"Open the Riders list."]
checks.action: Open the Riders list.
checks.expected: The colourless rider has a colour no other rider holds. The picker greys the colours the others hold.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0668.2"],"As the Red rider, pick the route with the steep climb. Read the cockpit before START, then tap the rider."]
checks.action: As the Red rider, pick the route with the steep climb. Read the cockpit before START, then tap the rider.
checks.expected: Title line: no rider. Bar: the Red rider's mark and name on the left, ignoring taps; START in the middle. Red terrain bike.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0668.3"],"Press START and ride to the steep climb, with the Red rider's own ghost on."]
checks.action: Press START and ride to the steep climb, with the Red rider's own ghost on.
checks.expected: The rider stays in the bar beside PAUSE and FINISH. The Red terrain bike stands out from the red band and the initialled ghost.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0668.4"],"Discard. Pick a structured HR-Zone workout and read the cockpit before START."]
checks.action: Discard. Pick a structured HR-Zone workout and read the cockpit before START.
checks.expected: The HR-Zone terrain shows the rider before START, as the Power and Route terrains do.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0668.5"],"Discard. Open Free Ride, Quick Ride and Zone Ride, reading the bottom bar. In one, press START, then Pause."]
checks.action: Discard. Open Free Ride, Quick Ride and Zone Ride, reading the bottom bar. In one, press START, then Pause.
checks.expected: In each, the rider on the bar's left, START beside it. The rider stays while pedalling, beside PAUSE and FINISH; after Pause, RESUME and FINISH.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0668.6"],"Switch to the Orange rider and repeat the Red rider's route."]
checks.action: Switch to the Orange rider and repeat the Red rider's route.
checks.expected: The bar's mark and the terrain bike are Orange, and the bar names the Orange rider. The Red rider's ghost, if shown, is Red.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0676.1","TST-0676.2"],"Start a structured Power workout. Look at the whole cockpit, then read power, heart rate and cadence."]
checks.action: Start a structured Power workout. Look at the whole cockpit, then read power, heart rate and cadence.
checks.expected: The profile takes about a third of the space above the bottom bar or more. The bar shows the rider and START whole. Each number sits whole on one line. Heart rate and cadence are the same size, and power is the largest.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0676.3"],"Discard. Start a structured HR-Zone workout and look at the terrain."]
checks.action: Discard. Start a structured HR-Zone workout and look at the terrain.
checks.expected: The HR-Zone profile is visible, about as tall as the Power workout's.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0676.4"],"Discard. Start a Route ride and look at the terrain."]
checks.action: Discard. Start a Route ride and look at the terrain.
checks.expected: The route's terrain is at least as tall as the Power workout's profile.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0676.5"],"Discard. Start a Free Ride. Tap − and + on the slope, then on the gear row, several times each."]
checks.action: Discard. Start a Free Ride. Tap − and + on the slope, then on the gear row, several times each.
checks.expected: Each tap lands on the button aimed at. The slope stays on one line, and the gear row reads a small GEAR beside larger numbers.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0676.6"],"Discard. Start a Quick Ride and tap − and + on the target watts several times."]
checks.action: Discard. Start a Quick Ride and tap − and + on the target watts several times.
checks.expected: Each tap lands on the button aimed at, and the target watts, such as `124W`, stay whole on one line.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0676.7"],"Discard. Start a Zone Ride and look at the terrain."]
checks.action: Discard. Start a Zone Ride and look at the terrain.
checks.expected: The Zone Ride terrain is visible.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0676.8"],"Discard. Start a Route ride with repeat set to 1. Read the line under heart rate, power and cadence."]
checks.action: Discard. Start a Route ride with repeat set to 1. Read the line under heart rate, power and cadence.
checks.expected: Each shows LAP, AVG and MAX. Where one line is too narrow, LAP n sits above AVG n | MAX n. Nothing split or cut.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0676.9"],"Start the structured Power workout again and look at the whole cockpit."]
checks.action: Start the structured Power workout again and look at the whole cockpit.
checks.expected: The terrain is still visible, and no number is cut off or broken across lines.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0676.10"],"Discard. Start a Route ride and read the gear row."]
checks.action: Discard. Start a Route ride and read the gear row.
checks.expected: GEAR and its numbers stay on one line, and nothing is cut off.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0677.1"],"Discard. Ride any workout for a minute, then tap FINISH and read the dialog."]
checks.action: Discard. Ride any workout for a minute, then tap FINISH and read the dialog.
checks.expected: The dialog is a sheet at the bottom; its eyebrow, title and totals are readable, and nothing is cut off at the sides.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0677.2"],"Scroll the dialog to its end."]
checks.action: Scroll the dialog to its end.
checks.expected: Save ride, Keep riding and Discard ride are all visible.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0677.3"],"Tap Keep riding, finish again, tap Save ride, and scroll the celebration to its end."]
checks.action: Tap Keep riding, finish again, tap Save ride, and scroll the celebration to its end.
checks.expected: Keep riding returns to the ride; after Save ride, the celebration's numbers, zones and Done can all be reached.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0677.4"],"Pick Heart Rate in the ride-mode strip and read the header above the list."]
checks.action: Pick Heart Rate in the ride-mode strip and read the header above the list.
checks.expected: The title and every header button are whole, and at least one workout row is visible.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0677.5"],"As the rider with saved rides, open History. Expand the stats card, then a ride, and scroll its charts."]
checks.action: As the rider with saved rides, open History. Expand the stats card, then a ride, and scroll its charts.
checks.expected: The This Week cards and every chart are whole, and no chart hides another or the text under it.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0677.6"],"Open the rider screen and scroll to the last rider."]
checks.action: Open the rider screen and scroll to the last rider.
checks.expected: Every rider and every rider's actions can be reached.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0669.5"],"Repeat the four destinations, from reading the container to opening Settings."]
checks.action: Repeat the four destinations, from reading the container to opening Settings.
checks.expected: The same four destinations sit in a left rail, Settings at its foot.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0676.11"],"Open the latest CI run of the candidate's commit and find the result of TST-0679's iOS layout grid."]
checks.action: Open the latest CI run of the candidate's commit and find the result of TST-0679's iOS layout grid.
checks.expected: TST-0679's `CockpitLayoutRulesTests` passed. Its scale rule fails if an iPad that fitted before FEAT-0131 draws the cockpit below scale 1.0 (`tabletsThatFit`).

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0680.1"],"Open Workouts and read the four equipment icons in the top bar."]
checks.action: Open Workouts and read the four equipment icons in the top bar.
checks.expected: Trainer, power and cadence are plain, in the bar's text colour. Heart rate is faint grey with a diagonal slash.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0680.2"],"Open the Hub from the icons and read each row's icon. Close it."]
checks.action: Open the Hub from the icons and read each row's icon. Close it.
checks.expected: Row icons match the top bar; no tile is in the accent colour. Heart rate: slashed, on a dashed tile, *Not set up*.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","the-navigation-container-the-equipment-chrome-and-the-rider-token",["TST-0680.3"],"Open a structured Power workout and read the bottom of the cockpit."]

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","simulation-and-the-gear-table-on-a-trainer-that-accepts-control",["TST-0120"],"Look at the slope and gear rows. Tap each control once, and shift a gear up and down."]

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","simulation-and-the-gear-table-on-a-trainer-that-accepts-control",["TST-0158"],"Shift to gear 26 and ride it."]

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","simulation-and-the-gear-table-on-a-trainer-that-accepts-control",["TST-0156"],"Set the slope to 0 %, shift to gear 1, and ride the floor."]

checks.action: Keep pressing minus at the floor.

checks.action: With the target at 30 W, pedal.
checks.expected: The trainer holds the 30 W target without oscillating.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","simulation-and-the-gear-table-on-a-trainer-that-accepts-control",["TST-0122"],"Adjust the watts several times, riding a little at each. Watch the terrain view."]

checks.action: Look at the FTP line. End, switch Theme between Light and Dark, start Quick Ride, look again. Switch back.

checks.expected: A target watt value from grade, speed and weight, held via 0x05 at any cadence. Shifting gears changes the target.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","simulation-and-the-gear-table-on-a-trainer-that-accepts-control",["TST-0138.3"],"Set Slope behaviour to Auto. Start and end a Free Ride, and read the log."]

checks.action: Start Sweet Spot Base, end it once the first interval starts, and read the log.
checks.expected: ERG mode sends 0x05, target power.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","simulation-and-the-gear-table-on-a-trainer-that-accepts-control",["TST-0138.4"],"Swap in the trainer without SIM support, as the setup says. Start and end a Free Ride; read the log."]

sections.name: Final sweep: languages and what is left

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0330.1"],"Open About and tap Manual & Guides."]
checks.action: Open About and tap Manual & Guides.
checks.expected: The card is shaped like Privacy Policy and Email Support, and opens `https://www.your-applications.com/your-trainer/manual.html`, linking four sub-pages.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0330.5"],"Open each contextual learn-more link and note its URL. Look for the links on other screens."]
checks.action: Open each contextual learn-more link and note its URL. Look for the links on other screens.
checks.expected: Prompt tips, right-aligned under the goal field, opens `…/ai-skills.html`, schema docs `…/workout-schema.html`, Troubleshoot `…/troubleshooting.html`. Not on AI Coach, Workout Selection or the ride screen.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0634.1"],"Read the connection path from the top-bar Hub. Pick a workout with no heart-rate monitor to reach its prompt."]
checks.action: Read the connection path from the top-bar Hub. Pick a workout with no heart-rate monitor to reach its prompt.
checks.expected: Each reads connect, connected or disconnected, and never pair or paired.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0634.2"],"Read every place on the connection path that names the surface."]
checks.action: Read every place on the connection path that names the surface.
checks.expected: The surface is named **Equipment Hub** wherever it is named.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0638.1"],"Read the copy for who its subject is."]
checks.action: Read the copy for who its subject is.
checks.expected: It is written with the product as the subject, not the developer — no *I built*, no *I'll send*.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0638.2"],"Read the same copy for how it opens and how it addresses the rider."]
checks.action: Read the same copy for how it opens and how it addresses the rider.
checks.expected: There are no motivational-imperative openers and no second-person stacking.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0638.3"],"Read the same copy for its English cadence."]
checks.action: Read the same copy for its English cadence.
checks.expected: British-English cadence — *household* rather than *whole family*, *one-time purchase* rather than *buy once*.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0329.1"],"In Settings → Language, tap App language and pick Deutsch. Fully close and reopen the app."]
checks.action: In Settings → Language, tap App language and pick Deutsch. Fully close and reopen the app.
checks.expected: The picker lists System Default and eight languages. After the restart Settings is in German: titles, subtitles and buttons.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0329.2"],"Visit Profile, Workouts, History and the Active Workout screen."]
checks.action: Visit Profile, Workouts, History and the Active Workout screen.
checks.expected: Profile, Workouts, History and the Active Workout screen are in German too.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0329.3"],"In Settings → Language, find the language-feedback row and tap it."]
checks.action: In Settings → Language, find the language-feedback row and tap it.
checks.expected: `Übersetzungsfehler entdeckt?` with `Melden`, no arrow. The email to `support@your-applications.com`: German prompts, English Locale and Version lines, subject `Your Trainer — Language feedback (<locale>) — v<version>`.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0330.2"],"Set the language to German and restart. Open Manual & Guides and every contextual link, and note each URL."]
checks.action: Set the language to German and restart. Open Manual & Guides and every contextual link, and note each URL.
checks.expected: The manual opens `…/de/manual.html`, which redirects to the English page, and all four contextual URLs include `/de/`.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0329.4"],"Pick 日本語 and restart. Open the picker, then revisit Profile, Workouts, History and the Active Workout screen."]
checks.action: Pick 日本語 and restart. Open the picker, then revisit Profile, Workouts, History and the Active Workout screen.
checks.expected: Japanese renders everywhere the German pass touched, with no missing glyphs, tofu boxes or clipped characters.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0329.5"],"Reopen the picker in Settings → Language, choose System Default, and restart."]
checks.action: Reopen the picker in Settings → Language, choose System Default, and restart.
checks.expected: The app returns to the device's own language, English.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0330.3"],"Set the language to English and restart. Open Manual & Guides and every contextual link, and note each URL."]
checks.action: Set the language to English and restart. Open Manual & Guides and every contextual link, and note each URL.
checks.expected: Every URL is a bare path such as `…/manual.html`, with no locale segment.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0330.4"],"With the app closed, open `https://www.your-applications.com/your-trainer/de/manual.html` in a desktop browser."]
checks.action: With the app closed, open `https://www.your-applications.com/your-trainer/de/manual.html` in a desktop browser.
checks.expected: The DE stub redirects to EN from a plain browser.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0496.1"],"Restart so the app reads Dutch. Open the English-only workout and read its banner."]
checks.action: Restart so the app reads Dutch. Open the English-only workout and read its banner.
checks.expected: The banner reads exactly "Deze workout is in het Engels — vertalen naar het Nederlands?"

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0342.2"],"Note the count on Translate all my workouts. Start it and tap Cancel mid-workout. Start it again."]
checks.action: Note the count on Translate all my workouts. Start it and tap Cancel mid-workout. Start it again.
checks.expected: Cancel stops the queue without discarding the in-flight result, and the action is resumable.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0342.1"],"Let the run finish. Read the counter and completion count, then open a translated workout."]
checks.action: Let the run finish. Read the counter and completion count, then open a translated workout.
checks.expected: The count badge, the per-workout counter and the completion line all agree with what translated. A translated workout opens in the new language.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0496.2"],"Read the auto-translate toggle, the bulk action's subtitle and its completion message."]
checks.action: Read the auto-translate toggle, the bulk action's subtitle and its completion message.
checks.expected: `Geïmporteerde workouts automatisch vertalen`, `Vertaal elke workout in een andere taal naar het Nederlands.` and `… workouts vertaald naar het Nederlands.`

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0496.3"],"Read the call to action on the equipment connection screen, then the introduction in About."]
checks.action: Read the call to action on the equipment connection screen, then the introduction in About.
checks.expected: `Start Training` and `trainingservaring` unchanged.

checks.key: ["REL-0017","ios","final-sweep-languages-and-what-is-left",["TST-0637"],"In each Tier-1 language, open every changed screen and note any stray English. End on System default."]
checks.action: In each Tier-1 language, open every changed screen and note any stray English. End on System default.
checks.expected: Every rider-facing label, button, dialog body, empty state and toast is translated, with no stray English. Brand nouns stay in English: intervals.icu, Strava, Your Trainer, FTMS.
